requirements.text: The personalised timetable management should include features for colour-coding modules.
The personalised timetable management should allow the ability to hide cancelled classes.
The personalised timetable management should include an option for students to add their own study blocks.
The automated notifications must provide alerts for grades.
The automated notifications must include reminders for upcoming assignment deadlines.
The automated notifications must provide notifications for exam dates.
The structured module feedback system should allow students to provide insights on content quality.
The structured module feedback system should allow students to provide insights on delivery methods.
The structured module feedback system should allow students to provide insights on available resources.
The feedback system must be straightforward to facilitate easy student participation.
The feedback system must have a structured approach for gathering insights.
All new features must integrate with the existing authentication system.
All new features must align with university policies to ensure stability and compliance.
